business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Tax Structuring and Transfer Pricing Advisory

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain (unitary national jurisdiction; no separate sub-state corporate code for this pipeline)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Spain–United States Income Tax Convention (1990, as amended by the 2010 Protocol)
EU–Mexico Global Agreement and EU–Colombia/Peru/Ecuador Trade Agreement (investment-relevant EU instruments)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, por el que se aprueba el Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010; Real Decreto 217/2020, de 10 de marzo, as amended, governing mandatory ultimate beneficial owner notification to the Registro Mercantil Central and the Registro de Titularidad Real; Real Decreto-ley 7/2021, de 27 de abril, transposing Directive (EU) 2018/843 into the Spanish legal order.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and good standing of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent commercial court in the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the country of origin, followed by sworn Spanish translation; non-Apostille jurisdictions require consular legalization at the competent Spanish Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified corporate resolution and power of attorney authorizing incorporation of the Spanish SL
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or corporate registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; if executed before a Spanish notary, protocolización de la escritura suffices

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial ownership declaration and corporate ownership chart for the entire shareholder chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate legal representative or foreign obliged entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certificate of the declaration, apostilled or consular legalized, with sworn Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Valid passport or national identity document of each director and individual beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National civil registry, police authority, or competent issuing state ministry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy certified by a foreign notary and apostilled; accepted as part of the Spanish notary's KYC file for the incorporación

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds evidence for the share capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Deposit-taking bank or credit institution where the shareholder maintains relevant accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original banker's letter on bank letterhead, apostilled or consular legalized, with sworn Spanish translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, attorneys-in-fact, and UBOs against domestic and international lists before incorporation, including Spanish Consejo de Seguridad Nacional sanctions, European Union autonomous sanctions, UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, and the Spanish PEP database maintained under Law 10/2010. Enhanced due diligence is required where any UBO is a PEP, a family member of a PEP, or a known close associate; screening results, documentary evidence, and negative-match explanations must be preserved in the AML file for a minimum of ten years and be available on request to SEPBLAC and the commercial register.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central, Ministerio de Justicia — Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social online system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed company name must be in Spanish or in a co-official Spanish language (Catalan, Basque, or Galician); foreign words are permitted if written using Latin alphabet characters; the registry normalizes accents and diacritics; the name cannot be identical or phonetically/significantly similar to any existing Spanish company name, and the corporate type suffix 'S.L.' or 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' must appear in the full denomination.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Términos que impliquen una actividad regulada sin autorización administrativa previa
Términos que induzcan a confusión con entidades públicas, partidos políticos, orden público o la identidad nacional
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The negative denomination certificate is not administratively extendable; after expiry, a new application may be filed if the name remains available. If the Registro Mercantil Central rejects the proposed denomination or certifies that it is unavailable, the applicant may submit a written appeal (recurso de alzada) to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within one month, attaching the registry notification and legal arguments, and may simultaneously request a fresh denomination certificate. A dismissed administrative appeal may be challenged before the Sala de lo Contencioso-Administrativo of the Audiencia Nacional within two months.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a low-risk tax consultancy SL only if a physical Spanish registered address is provided where notifications can be validly served and statutory records are available; a pure mailbox or virtual-only address is accepted by the registry but increases the risk that the tax authorities will disregard the Spanish seat, and genuine commercial substance with local management, personnel, and decision-making is required for cross-border tax structuring and transfer-pricing arrangements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate quantified risk: approximately 15% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by SEPBLAC, the AEAT, or the social/labor inspectorate for a low-risk professional services SL; the probability rises above 50% if the company files for tax rulings, claims treaty relief, invoices significant intercompany services, or is selected by the Spanish tax administration's risk algorithms.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registrar tariff per Spanish Mercantile Registry regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Inscription of the deed in the Registro Mercantil
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff based on nominal capital and number of registration entries

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille, consular legalization, and sworn translations of foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent foreign authorities and Spanish official translation services
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Convention / consular fee schedules plus prevailing market benchmark for traducción jurada

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO piercing, PEP, OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Professional fee under AML Law 10/2010 and prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal counsel for preparation of bylaws, UBO declarations, and preliminary cross-border tax structuring
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee or hourly professional fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, Texto Refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC). Key provisions: Article 4 (minimum share capital for SL), Articles 20-22 (pre-incorporation agreements), Articles 33-42 (public deed and registration), Article 52 (registered office), Article 62 (bank deposit of capital). Supplementary: Ley 14/2013 (NIE facilitation for investors), Real Decreto 424/2017 (CIRCE single electronic document), Ley 10/2010 (anti-money laundering beneficial ownership filing).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central for name certification; Registro Mercantil Provincial for definitive inscription of the corporate deed; notified through the CIRCE (Centro de Información y Red de Creación de Empresas) system.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (public deed of incorporation) with annexed Articles of Association, submitted for registration together with NIF Form 036/037 and the negative name certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital of EUR 3,000 fully subscribed and paid up in cash at incorporation (Art. 4 LSC). Funds must be placed in a blocked escrow account at a Spanish credit institution and evidenced by a bank certificate; release is permitted only after inscription in the Commercial Registry. Alternative notarial declaration of bank guarantee is admissible.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE SOLE INCORPORATOR OF [COMPANY NAME], S.L. 1. Share capital: The capital of EUR 3,000 is subscribed and fully paid in cash by the founding members; the bank deposit certificate is approved and annexed. 2. Registered office: The registered office is fixed at the address stated in article 7 of the bylaws, which address also constitutes the fiscal domicile for corporate income tax purposes. 3. Appointments: [FULL NAME] is appointed Sole Administrator, accepting the office and exercising all representation powers; [FULL NAME] is appointed Secretary of the company. 4. Mandate: The Administrator is instructed to execute this deed, obtain the tax identification number, effect registration with the Commercial Registry, apply for the municipal operating license, and complete all ancillary post-incorporation formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Procurement of Negative Company Name Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry) via the official online portal or CIRCE.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application requesting a 'certificación negativa de denominación social' with up to three proposed corporate names in priority order. The Central Registry checks the integrated database of Spanish and EU company names. The certificate is valid for three months and must be attached to the public deed.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association (for cross-check of the corporate object)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name coincides with or is misleading for an existing entity, resubmit an application with three fresh alternatives; no fee is forfeited and the validity period restarts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Spanish NIE for Foreign Founding Members and Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de la Policía - Comisaría General de Extranjería y Fronteras, processed at Spanish diplomatic missions abroad or central police stations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File form EX-15 together with passport and proof of economic interest; the NIE (Número de Identificación de Extranjero) is assigned immediately at the consulate or within 48-72 hours at police stations. The NIE is a precondition for the notary to verify capacity of foreign founders.
required_dossiers: Valid passport with entry stamp or consular visa
Apostilled criminal record certificate from country of residence
Statement of investment or incorporation interest
Spanish postal or consular address proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried due to address documentation, rectify by submitting a certified local certificate and re-appoint the consular appointment; the process is free and repeatable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Capital Escrow Bank Deposit and Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution authorized by Banco de España.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the 'Sociedad Limitada en formación' and deposit the subscribed capital of at least EUR 3,000. Obtain a bank certificate (certificación bancaria de ingreso) stating depositor, amount, and escrow/blocked nature in the form required by the notary under Art. 62 LSC. Alternatively, the founders may use the notarial guarantee declaration where funds are withheld by the notary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank issues the certificate with wrong caption because the SL is not yet registered, instruct issuance under 'SL en formación' or request the notarial guarantee alternative within the same time frame.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Public Incorporation Deed and Stamp Duty Settlement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario in the province of the registered office; Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) for Form 600 (ITP/AJD).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attend the notary appointment personally or through attorneys; the notary verifies legal capacity, the bank capital certificate, name certificate, bylaw conformity and board resolution, then reads and executes the deed. The notary issues the authorized protocol copy and files the self-assessment of AJD at 1% of share capital (if deed is executed in Spain) through Form 600 within 30 business days.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney if signed through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary suspends for missing document, complete the dossier and reset the appointment; for late Form 600 filing, pay the corresponding surcharge under Art. 27 LGT and submit the self-assessment to the regional tax office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Provincial Commercial Registry and BORME Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial corresponding to the registered office; publication through the Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil (BORME).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the authorized copy of the public deed, the negative name certificate and the paid Form 600 receipt, either physically or electronically via the CIRCE channel used by the notary. The registrar has one month to qualify (calificación registral). Upon favorable inscription the company acquires legal personality, and a brief extract is published in the BORME.
required_dossiers: Authorized copy (copia autorizada) of the public deed
No-tax-liens certificate or statement where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of a negative qualification, the notary or founders must cure the defect within the suspension period; an unsuccessful cure may be appealed as a 'recurso gubernativo' to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive Corporate Tax ID and Beneficial Ownership Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) local tax management office; beneficial ownership filing through the Registro Mercantil Central coordinated with the SEPBLAC.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the registry inscription proof at the AEAT office that granted the provisional NIF to convert it into the definitive corporate tax ID (NIF definitivo) via Form 036/037 within one month of inscription. Concurrently, file the Beneficial Ownership Declaration (declaración de titular real) identifying the ultimate natural persons owning or controlling the company, as required by Ley 10/2010 and Ley 19/2018.
required_dossiers: Beneficial ownership model with shareholding chain documentation
Identity documents of ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT detects a mismatch, file a rectifying Form 036 before penalties accrue; for the beneficial ownership declaration, submit a complementary filing within the same month and self-correct to avoid sanctions under Ley 10/2010.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Business Activity License and Physical Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ayuntamiento of the registered office (Unidad de Actividades y Licencias), coordinated where necessary with the competent Consejería of the Autonomous Community.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Determine whether the municipal ordinance requires a full 'Licencia de Apertura' or only a 'Declaración Responsable de Inicio de Actividad'. For a tertiary professional office, usually the declaration suffices; attach the fire-safety and structural compliance report, the municipal surface plan, the workplace risk-prevention documentation (Ley 31/1995), public liability insurance and the municipal fee receipt. The open declaration permits immediate operation while pending inspection.
required_dossiers: Technical fire-safety and structural conformity report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a license is denied or the declaration is queried, obtain a technical engineer certification for the premises, correct deficiencies in fire or accessibility works, and re-submit; an as-built regularization ('licencia de legalización') is available for already-occupied premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ayuntamiento of the registered office - Unidad de Licencias de Actividad; sectoral informational registry with the Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo only where service-sector inscription is required for professional cross-border consultancy.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Apertura / Declaración Responsable de Inicio de Actividad for professional office (despacho profesional) dedicated to international tax structuring and transfer pricing advisory.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITRED) and the Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the Autonomous Community where the registered office is located.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category Exempt / Group D - no full EIA. A consultancy office does not fall under Annex I or II of Ley 21/2013; only a municipal 'Comunicación Ambiental' is requested where the office generates minor urban waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Municipal wastewater connection thresholds per Real Decreto 1021/2022: BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/l, COD ≤ 500 mg/l, TSS ≤ 250 mg/l, pH 6-9.5; no VOC or industrial emission thresholds apply as no manufacturing installations are present; compliance with CTE/HE thermal envelope requirements and separate waste-collection obligations under Ley 7/2022 (paper, batteries, electronics).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certificate per Real Decreto 513/2017 (SIANE): adequate extinguishers, emergency lighting and exit signage; structural load and occupancy conformity certificate for the leased premises; workplace health-and-safety documentation under Ley 31/1995 and RD 486/1997 including workstation layout and evacuation plan; municipal certificate of first occupation (cédula de habitabilidad/primera ocupación) where the building has not previously been cleared for tertiary use.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Tributaria, the Spanish Tax Agency, with official portal at https://www.agenciatributaria.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Spanish entities such as the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada obtain their NIF during incorporation via the Registro Mercantil Central. Foreign entities must register with the Agencia Tributaria using Form 036, submitting incorporation documents, tax residency proof, and business plans to obtain a NIF for Spanish operations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; Spain applies hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD Directive 2017/952 and permits special regimes such as the Simplified Regime for Small Businesses.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 50,000 euros annual turnover threshold triggering mandatory VAT registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory SII (Sistema de Información Inmediata) for real-time electronic invoicing, digital stamping, and API reporting for compliant taxpayers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to goods exported outside the EU upon proof of export; offshore services qualify if provided to non-EU customers with no Spanish establishment and compliant invoicing.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating claims incur penalties up to 100% of evaded VAT plus interest; retrospective clawback applies with surcharges and potential criminal tax evasion sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), operating within the Eurosystem under the monetary authority of the European Central Bank; foreign-exchange and capital-movement rules are principally derived from European Union law and Spanish Law 19/2003 on the legal regime of capital movements and economic transactions with foreign countries.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain uses the euro, which is fully convertible for current-account and capital-account transactions. There is no general exchange-control approval for importing capital, paying suppliers, receiving service fees, repatriating dividends, or remitting liquidation proceeds. A Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada may maintain euro and foreign-currency accounts and transfer funds internationally, subject to anti-money-laundering, sanctions, tax, beneficial-ownership, and statistical-reporting obligations. Profit remittance is generally unrestricted after approval of annual accounts, satisfaction of statutory reserve requirements, coverage of prior losses, and verification that the distribution does not impair net equity. Spanish withholding tax may apply to dividends, interest, royalties, or other outbound payments, subject to domestic exemptions and applicable tax treaties. Payments to related parties must comply with Spanish transfer-pricing, corporate-benefit, documentation, and substance requirements. Certain foreign investments and transactions may require ex post declarations, and strategic-sector investments can be subject to foreign-investment screening or authorization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain has no general statutory requirement to surrender export proceeds to the Bank of Spain, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no universal deadline for converting foreign-currency export receipts into euros. Export proceeds may remain in foreign-currency accounts or be converted at the company's discretion. The company must retain commercial, customs, invoice, shipping, and payment evidence and satisfy applicable tax, accounting, AML, sanctions, and statistical-reporting requirements. Bank reporting may apply to cross-border transactions, foreign accounts, foreign assets, or investment positions, including declarations requested by the Bank of Spain or the Spanish Tax Agency. Any transaction-specific reporting deadline depends on the applicable reporting form, threshold, sector, or regulatory regime rather than on an export-proceeds surrender rule.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium to High for transactional operations, subject to the provider's authorization, passporting status, risk appetite, and supported countries. An EU-authorized electronic-money institution or payment institution may provide payment accounts, SEPA transfers, card acquiring, and certain foreign-currency services in Spain under the applicable passporting framework. An electronic-money institution does not provide bank deposits or deposit-guarantee protection, and safeguarded customer funds must be segregated in accordance with applicable law. An offshore provider without EU authorization, valid passporting, or a permitted local distribution arrangement may not lawfully provide regulated payment services to the Spanish company. Fintech onboarding can be restricted for tax-advisory businesses handling client funds, complex ownership chains, high-risk jurisdictions, virtual assets, or substantial third-party payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Spanish banks may permit remote onboarding through qualified electronic identification, video identification, electronic signatures, and certified corporate documents, but no universal right to remote account opening exists. The bank may require a branch visit, live video interview, notarized or apostilled documents, certified translations, verification of directors and ultimate beneficial owners, or a visit by an authorized signatory. A non-resident shareholder or director does not automatically have to appear physically, but the bank may impose that requirement based on nationality, residence, ownership complexity, source of funds, business model, or sanctions and AML risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident or multi-layered ownership structure with unclear ultimate beneficial ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current commercial-register extracts for every relevant entity; notarized articles and shareholder registers; certified ownership chart to each natural-person ultimate beneficial owner; passports and residential-address evidence; director appointment evidence; beneficial-owner declaration; corporate-authority resolutions; and a written explanation of the ownership and control chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-structuring and transfer-pricing advisory activity perceived as an offshore tax-evasion, secrecy, or aggressive-tax-planning risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan; service descriptions; client onboarding and acceptance policy; engagement-letter template; professional-services website and credentials; tax-compliance policy; confirmation that the company does not provide nominee, concealment, undeclared-account, or illicit tax-evasion services; sample invoices; expected client and country profile; and explanation of applicable professional, legal, and ethical controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained initial capital, shareholder loans, intercompany transfers, or significant inbound funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder and board resolutions; subscription or loan agreements; bank statements showing the originating account; audited or management accounts of the funder; tax returns or financial statements; proof of accumulated wealth and source of funds; capital-contribution documentation; notarial incorporation records; and a transaction-flow memorandum linking the transfer to the stated corporate purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected international payments involving high-risk, sanctioned, embargoed, or weakly regulated jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Country and counterparty risk matrix; sanctions-screening procedure; beneficial-owner checks for customers and suppliers; underlying contracts, invoices, and delivery evidence; end-use and end-user statements; payment-routing policy; escalation records; and a commitment to reject prohibited or suspicious transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High volume of third-party receipts, pass-through funds, client-money activity, or payments unrelated to the company's own services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Funds-flow map; written confirmation that the company will not hold or transmit client money unless separately authorized; customer and supplier lists; contractual basis for each payment category; segregation policy; reconciliation controls; accounting policy; transaction limits; and explanation of why each expected payment is proportionate to the advisory business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared tax-consultancy activity and payment behavior, including cash intensity, card settlements, crypto exposure, or unusually large foreign-currency turnover.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month cash-flow forecast; expected monthly transaction counts and values; currency exposure analysis; payment-purpose matrix; management accounts; tax registrations; proof of premises and personnel; customer contracts; accounting-system extracts; and documented approval controls for exceptional transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Missing, expired, non-apostilled, untranslated, or inconsistent corporate and personal identification documents.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Recently issued registry certificates; legalized or apostilled constitutional documents where required; sworn Spanish translations where required; valid identity documents; proof of address; tax identification numbers; electronic-signature certificates; and a document-index schedule identifying issuance dates, validity periods, and responsible signatories.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route paid-in share capital through a bank or payment institution able to identify the Spanish SL, the subscribing shareholder, and the ultimate source of funds. Use a dedicated capital-contribution or incorporation account where required by the bank and obtain the bank certificate for the notarial incorporation or capital increase. The transfer narrative should state the legal entity name, Spanish tax identification number when available, shareholder identity, and purpose such as paid-in share capital or shareholder loan. Maintain the subscription agreement, shareholder or board resolution, notarial deed, bank transfer confirmation, source-of-funds evidence, and accounting entry. For later capital increases, coordinate the transfer with the notarial deed and Commercial Registry filing. Distinguish equity, shareholder loans, service payments, and dividends; do not use generic descriptions that obscure the legal nature of the payment. The bank may request information relevant to Bank of Spain statistics, foreign-investment declarations, tax reporting, AML review, or foreign-exchange documentation. Do not split transfers to avoid scrutiny or reporting thresholds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer for euro payments within the SEPA area, subject to correct IBAN and beneficiary-name controls. Use SWIFT MT103 or its ISO 20022 equivalent for non-SEPA or multi-currency bank transfers, including complete originator, beneficiary, intermediary-bank, invoice, contract, and purpose information. Use a commercial documentary letter of credit for higher-risk goods or counterparties where payment is conditioned on compliant transport, insurance, customs, inspection, and commercial documents. Documentary collections, open-account payments, and bank guarantees may be used following counterparty and country-risk approval. Match each payment to a valid invoice, purchase or service contract, delivery evidence, customs documentation where relevant, and accounting record. Apply sanctions screening, dual-use and export-control checks, VAT treatment, withholding-tax analysis, transfer-pricing controls for related parties, and segregation of payment approval from preparation. Retain payment messages and supporting documents for the statutory accounting, tax, AML, and audit periods.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EUR/foreign-currency forwards entered into with an authorized EU bank or regulated investment firm for documented commercial exposures.

Non-deliverable forwards for currencies or markets where physical delivery is restricted or operationally impracticable, subject to counterparty authorization, local-market legality, sanctions controls, and transaction documentation.

Currency swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps for documented funding or recurring currency exposures, subject to applicable EU derivatives regulation, including EMIR requirements where relevant.
Plain-vanilla currency options and option collars for genuine forecast or committed exposures, subject to suitability, appropriateness, disclosure, collateral, and accounting requirements.
Spot foreign-exchange conversions through an authorized bank or payment institution for operational receipts and disbursements.

Hedging policy controls requiring board-approved limits, documented underlying exposure, counterparty limits, confirmation procedures, valuation and collateral procedures, hedge-accounting assessment, independent reconciliation, and prohibition of speculative trading unrelated to the company's business.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts deposit (Depósito de Cuentas Anuales; Spanish GAAP financial statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil de la provincia del domicilio (Mercantile Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after shareholders' approval; approval must occur by 30 June for a 31 December year-end, making 30 July the final filing deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing daily surcharges and fines up to €1,500; closure of the Mercantile Registry file prevents all valid registrations until filed; after three consecutive non-filed years the company may be struck off administratively.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the 15th day of the 7th month after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year entity, 15 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 5% plus monthly late interest; administrative penalties up to 150% of the tax due; does not trigger strike-off but may lead to tax enforcement measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT summary return (Modelo 390) under the Spanish IVA regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 January following the calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty from €150 to €1,000 plus late-assessment interest; does not trigger administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 1 February following the calendar year, only if annual dealings with any counterparty exceed €3,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Flat fine of €150, plus €20 per missing item or €10 per inaccurate item; administrative penalties for incomplete data; no strike-off effect.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalization of statutory corporate books and UBO shareholder register update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil de la provincia del domicilio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Statutory books must be legalized before 30 April for a calendar year-end; UBO entries updated within one month of any share transfer and confirmed annually with the annual accounts deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry certificate of good standing cannot be obtained without compliance; UBO non-disclosure is an administrative offence with fines up to €3,000; persistent failure to update records justifies registry file closure.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies when the undertaking meets at least two of the following conditions for two consecutive fiscal years: total assets exceed €4,000,000; annual net turnover exceeds €8,000,000; average workforce exceeds 50 employees. Listed and public-interest entities are always subject to audit regardless of thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General de Contabilidad) enacted by Real Decreto 1/2021, with the abbreviated PGC PyME framework optional for qualifying small entities; consolidated groups may apply IFRS as adopted by the EU.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spain maintains a central beneficial-ownership registry operated through the Mercantile Registry. A Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada must submit an updated UBO statement within one month of any shareholding transfer that changes beneficial ownership. When there is no change, the annual accounts deposit serves as the annual confirmation; no separate annual UBO return is required for unchanged ownership structures.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Administradores)
Accounting Books: Inventories and Annual Accounts (Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 160 – USD 900 per year for registered office and corporate secretarial agent services in Spain
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 – USD 8,000 for a certified independent audit of a small-to-medium professional consultancy, excluding tax advisory deliverables

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% general rate; R&D super-deduction (100-200% extra), innovation patent regime, regional incentives (Basque Country/Navarre effective rates), accelerated depreciation
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: unlimited (perpetual carryforward), capped at 25% of taxable base per year

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 - Corporate Income Tax Return, mandatory electronic filing via AEAT (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria) portal using Cl@ve or digital certificate
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 days after end of tax year (e.g., 25 January for calendar year 2023 tax year)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate of all taxable income (operating, financial, extraordinary)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report solely Spanish-source income; foreign income excluded unless permanent establishment exists

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses, interest, personnel costs, depreciation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Spanish-source and economically justified expenses allowed; TP adjustments mandatory for intra-group transactions

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Taxable base and final tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income less deductions, minus tax credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply thin capitalization rules and transfer pricing adjustments; non-residents compute tax on Spanish source only

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 100€ per day surcharge (max 20,000€); undeclared income: 100% penalty plus interest; criminal evasion: fines up to 300% and imprisonment

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Apply to AEAT for Treaty Relief Certificate (TRC) via Form 210/211 with Spanish tax residency certificate, beneficial ownership declaration, and DTA application; reduced rate applied upon approval (typically 2-3 months processing)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19% statutory, reduced to 0-10% under most DTAs; Interest: 19% statutory, reduced to 0% under majority of DTAs per OECD model

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory if annual Spanish turnover exceeds 6 million EUR; Master File required if consolidated group turnover exceeds 50 million EUR
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain enforces OECD-aligned Economic Substance Regulations; non-genuine arrangements denied; holding, IP, financing entities must demonstrate real activities, adequate employees and premises

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: 100€ daily fine (max 20,000€) plus 100% penalty on undeclared income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several liability for tax debts; possible disqualification from company management and criminal prosecution

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Absence of TP documentation or failure to apply arm's length principle
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority adjustments increasing taxable base by full amount of adjustment; penalties up to 100% of undeclared plus interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal civil and criminal liability for fraudulent schemes; possible imprisonment and travel bans

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Payment of dividends to non-residents without 19% WHT or valid TRC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withholding tax due plus 100% penalty surcharge; possible criminal evasion charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for unpaid taxes; potential fines, disqualification and imprisonment for intentional non-compliance
